description:
Permanently deletes a work experience record from the user's GigHQ profile.

CRITICAL: Confirm with the user before calling. This cannot be undone. The backend also hard-deletes every Career Journal entry linked to this experience (experienceId), so those stories will be lost too.

Pass experience_uuid (preferred) or experience_id from list_experiences / get_profile.
